set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-research.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Run hosted H1/J1 only for owner-authorized corpora within the approved ceiling, with identical local comparison inputs and record/replay receipts. Unavailable or unauthorized arms remain not run; no participant text in Git.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: research. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Research comparison retained; frozen exposure/eligibility rules apply. Not an engineering prerequisite or proof of behavioral recovery.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1a Step 5, R4.

Hosted arms are optional for the checkpoint. They run only on corpora the owner authorizes, within the spend ceiling; Jev only with early access. Hosted weights cannot be pinned (ADR 0008), so recorded responses are the reproducibility artifact. This ticket closes either with the arms run or with a note recording which were not run and why; the final freeze waits for that closure.

Scope:
Run the authorized hosted arms with the same units, inputs and outcome typing as L1.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Runs only on corpora authorized by the hosted-API decision, within its ceiling; unauthorized corpora and unavailable providers are recorded as not run.
2. Same units, inputs and typed outcomes as L1; receipts carry provider, model id or version, and date; recorded responses are kept for replay; raw failures and budgeted retries stay in the receipt.
3. R4 is evaluated descriptively against L1 on identical development units.
4. No-redistribution conditions (e.g. FilmFestival README:46) are respected; nothing text-bearing is committed.
5. A ledger entry precedes the first gold read of any hosted arm.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: M.
